## AC4 "Checked by" clause amended (2026-11-04)

The amendment this epic's own earlier comment argued for has now been applied to the AC4
body. Until now the reasoning was recorded here while the clause itself still read the old
way, which left `e508` diverging from the epic's authoritative text rather than from a
corrected one. A plan review of `e508` caught exactly that gap.

**Before:** "Checked by: `f86e`'s overlay test asserting the taxonomy text is present in the
criterion's rubric."

**After:** `e508`'s calibration corpus (`R-reexport-*`/`FP-reexport-*`,
`R-importshape-*`/`FP-importshape-*`, `R-gatererun-*`/`FP-gatererun-*`) in
`src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/code-review-tests.eval.yaml`, plus `e508`'s offline pairing test
asserting each kind contributes exactly one fire case and one no-fire case.

**Why this is not an AC weakened to fit the work.** The SUBSTANCE of AC4 — that the `tests`
criterion carries a taxonomy distinguishing behaviour tests from five named antipattern
kinds — is unchanged, and is being built rather than waived. Three of those five kinds were
measured absent under every synonym and `e508` adds all three. Only the verification METHOD
changed, and it changed because the original method is forbidden by the artifact it
verifies: the rubric's Rule-5 exception classifies a prose-present grep whose only consumer
is the LLM as the `change-detector` antipattern — the very family this criterion ships. An
overlay test asserting the taxonomy text is present would therefore violate the taxonomy it
was meant to check.

The replacement is also strictly stronger as evidence. A prose grep shows the words are
present. A fire/no-fire corpus shows the entries discriminate real instances from
lookalikes, which is the property AC4 actually cares about.

**Effect on this epic's attestation.** Editing the description stales the signed
plan-review attestation as a material change. That is expected and is the correct order:
the parent is corrected first, then the leaf is re-reviewed against the corrected parent.
A fresh review will be run before this epic closes.

Remaining to close: `e508` is the last unclosed child.
